description: greenwashing gate: say at the start of a session when Node is missing or too old for the gate; record the start of each turn; at the end of a turn that changed code, run the tests and block the stop unless they passed

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/gate/hook.js" session || echo '{"systemMessage":"greenwashing: the gate is OFF - it needs Node.js 20 or newer, and node could not start it. No turn is checked until a human installs Node.js 20 or newer and restarts Claude Code."}'
